conditions.evidence: False arrhythmia alarms are a persistent problem in intensive care units
conditions.label: arrhythmia

output.population: Patients monitored in ICUs at three major US hospitals
output.summary: Benchmark of waveform recordings around ventricular tachycardia alarms from ICU bedside monitors, each alarm labeled true or false by at least two expert annotators, spanning three hospitals and three monitor manufacturers.
